brief.one_liner: Tech stocks took a bruising and bond markets rallied after a dramatic blue wave in US midterms sparked AI panic.

number.caption: Dollars wiped from the Nasdaq 100 in the massive AI selloff.

stories.title: Tech Titans Wobble as US Midterms Trigger AI Panic
stories.whats_going_on: The Nasdaq 100 wiped out $2.3 trillion as tech shares suffered their worst rout in years. A Democratic sweep in the US midterms sparked speculation that lawmakers will clamp down hard on the artificial intelligence industry.
stories.what_it_means: Investors rushed to re-evaluate sky-high tech valuations amid fears of looming regulatory hurdles and data centre limits. Safe-haven assets like Treasuries soared as traders rotated out of chips and high-flying growth stocks.
stories.why_care: For everyday investors holding broad market index funds or tech-heavy portfolios, days like this are a sharp reminder of how quickly sentiment can pivot.

stories.title: Bank of England Ups Rates, Eyes Inflation Pinch
stories.whats_going_on: The central bank raised interest rates for the first time in over three years. Officials warned that inflation is expected to climb to about 5 percent next year, sitting far above the official target.
stories.what_it_means: Policymakers are hitting the brakes to cool surging price pressures despite concerns over the broader cost of living. This marks a notable shift in monetary policy after a prolonged period of steady rates.
stories.why_care: If you are a borrower, expect upward pressure on variable loans and mortgages, while savers might eventually see slightly better returns on cash.

stories.title: Monzo Weighs Valuation as Fundraising Talks Continue
stories.whats_going_on: Digital lender Monzo is exploring a new fundraising round aiming for a £7.5bn valuation. This move follows the stall of potential private equity talks and a previous acquisition attempt.
stories.what_it_means: High-growth fintechs are continually recalibrating their worth in a shifting private funding environment. It highlights the ongoing appetite for scaling digital-first banking alternatives despite market headwinds.
stories.why_care: For everyday app users, it’s a peek behind the curtain at how modern challenger banks fund their expansion and chase long-term profitability.

stories.title: Bricks vs. Bytes: Housing Still Trails the S&P 500
stories.whats_going_on: New research reveals that the S&P 500’s annualized returns over the past 40 years outpaced housing-price returns across every US state and local market. While homes feel like solid investments, equities have quietly won the long-term marathon.
stories.what_it_means: Property offers tangible security and steady living utility, but liquid stock markets benefit from corporate compounding over decades. Past performance is never a guarantee of future results, but the historical gap is stark.
stories.why_care: It offers useful perspective for everyday savers trying to balance building a property deposit versus investing in diversified stock markets.
